title: CMD Kerala Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 22 Young Professional Posts
description: Centre for Management Development Kerala (CMD Kerala) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 22 Young Professional Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech, MBA, or M.Sc can use this chance and apply for the CMD Kerala Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply before the last date of application....
